teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, living room, dining room, balcony, garden, hall, room, floor

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, living room, dining room, balcony, garden, hall, room, floor
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How many rooms are there? (asking room count)
• There is a big kitchen (stating single room)
• There are two bedrooms (stating plural rooms)
• It has a sunny balcony (describing feature)
Pronunciation Focus:
Pronunciation of /θ/ in 'bathroom' and /tʃ/ in 'kitchen'.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Existence structures 'There is / There are' + Plural Nouns (There are three rooms)

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Existence structures 'There is / There are' + Plural Nouns (There are three rooms)
Controlled Practice:
There are three rooms where you sleep. What are they called?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Tell me about your new flat!
B: It is on the second floor. There is a living room, a kitchen, and two bedrooms.
A: Is there a balcony?
B: Yes, there is a small balcony near the living room.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to a real estate tour of an apartment and list all the rooms mentioned.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can name the rooms in a house or flat and describe what rooms my home has.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can name the rooms in a house or flat and describe what rooms my home has.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
